motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Existing --ease for settling, spatial feedback and clip reveals; no new primitive.

motion.name: hero-once
motion.value: stage 1000ms; headline 850ms 90ms; copy 700ms; overview 1100ms; reminder 1200ms; wallet 1350ms; records 650ms
motion.purpose: One initial hero sequence; action/reassurance delays 100/160ms and record delays 120/220/320ms. Logo stays static.

motion.name: intersection-reveals
motion.purpose: One-time intersection reveals, with content visible before enhancement.

motion.name: illustration-loops
motion.value: overview 8s; wallet 6s; bell 7s; organizer 8s; closing 7s; confirmation 7s
motion.purpose: CSS transform loops. All use ease-in-out except confirmation, which uses the settling curve. Run only with data-motion=on and intersecting scene; pause offscreen, in hidden documents, by user choice or reduced motion. Fine-pointer hover pauses feature/closing illustration loops. The organizer uses organizer-breathe in the retained stage wrapper, replacing the retired calendar sway.

motion.name: pointer-depth
motion.purpose: Fine mouse pointers only, one pending requestAnimationFrame per active visible scene, no React renders; layer depth factors differ and pointer leave resets depth. Paused/reduced motion disables handlers.

motion.name: action-feedback
motion.purpose: Bounded hover/focus feedback; 3px lift, 3px diagonal arrow and 4px downward round arrow. Reduced motion suppresses interactive transforms.

motion.name: navigation-feedback
motion.purpose: Header/footer section links reveal a left-origin underline on hover or keyboard focus; brand artwork remains still.

motion.name: sample-state
motion.value: period pill 350ms; label color 250ms; exact total 420ms
motion.purpose: Slide selection, then present the exact final amount with a 7px settle; polite atomic final-value announcement, no intermediate counted money.

motion.name: selection-feedback
motion.value: row fill 240ms; active scale 300ms; service-icon 350ms; check 240ms
motion.purpose: Native checkbox meaning remains explicit; trace/retract check strokes and preserve full-opacity excluded reading colors.

motion.name: faq-continuity
motion.value: grid rows 420ms; opacity 250ms; panel fill 300ms; indicator 350ms; vertical stroke 180ms
motion.purpose: Accessible controlled FAQ after hydration; native details fallback before JavaScript. Closed answer regions inert and hidden; reduced motion applies state immediately.

motion.name: feature-feedback
motion.purpose: Feature-hover icon lift/rotation and check trace, with reduced-motion override.

motion.name: motion-preference
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; document visibility; scene intersection; Pause/Play
motion.purpose: System reduced motion removes animations/transitions/smooth scrolling, zeros depth and suppresses transforms. Inline hero control appears after readiness unless reduced motion is enabled. Hover/reduced OS/hidden-tab behavior has not been fully exercised at runtime; no measured frame-rate claim.

motion.name: bento-feedback
motion.value: preview translate 400ms; month marker scale 450ms, color 300ms, per-marker delay 18ms
motion.purpose: Existing settling curve; reviewed-record previews lift 4px and monthly markers scaleY(1.65) on card hover. Reuse 850ms panel reveals. Local reduced-motion rules suppress transforms, shared rules suppress transitions; These hover responses coexist with separately gated decorative illustration loops.

motion.name: bento-illustration-loops
motion.value: cost coins 7s; bell 8s; statement papers 9s; receipt 9s; scan 9s; currency coins 10s; ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Decorative transparent assets start paused; root motion on and card in-view are required to play. Shared pause/hidden-document/reduced-motion gates apply. Reduced motion removes image/scan animation and hides the scan. Bell and scan have deliberate rest/invisible phases; short runtime samples did not verify complete cycles.

narrative.northStar: Forest and mint Subloom, made personal
narrative.overview:
This local specification describes the finished marketing surface. It inherits the established world in `../DESIGN.md`: forest and mint, Manrope headings, DM Sans reading text, rounded tonal panels, Lucide actions and tactile financial artwork. It does not revise the product-wide system. Spacious page composition, larger display type and pill actions are local marketing adaptations.

The warm paper ground and Mint illustration stage support the existing forest identity. A tilted sample overview, existing wallet and matching tactile organizer/bento artwork make subscription tracking tangible. Product truth remains governed by `../PRODUCT.md`; surface strategy remains in `.impeccable/surfaces/landing.md`.

Inheritance checked against parent DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md, `app/globals.css`, `app/layout.tsx`, `components/experience.tsx`, the surface contract and the reviewed desktop/tablet/mobile captures. Parent PRODUCT.md uses a legacy structure and its design sidecar was already flagged stale during context inspection. Those pre-existing issues remain untouched; this local record does not reconcile them.

The landing page uses the same fixed Fourfold Bloom identity as the native app. `../brand/source/identity.json` owns the four-petal symbol and outlined wordmark with an uppercase S; `../brand/GUIDE.md` governs their use. Light headers pair the Green mark with the Forest wordmark; dark fields use the Mint inverse. Personal app accents never change this logo.

The landing now supports System, Light and Dark appearance while preserving the same composition and brand geometry. Selected heading phrases use Green emphasis and occasional underlines under the owner’s explicit landing-only direction; the app-wide brand rules remain unchanged. Generated light/dark social previews reuse the exact canonical logo, local fonts and existing wallet artwork.
keyCharacteristics: One generated Fourfold Bloom mark and outlined wordmark across app and website.
Semantic light/dark surfaces and paired action colors, with fixed brand-logo colors.
Green heading keywords and selective underlines scoped to this landing page.
Manrope display hierarchy with DM Sans controls and reading text.
Flat rounded panels alongside a coherent forest-green, ivory and restrained-gold financial illustration family.
Product-specific bento previews connect forgotten recurring costs with reviewed records and renewal planning.
One-time hero choreography, gated illustration loops and bounded interaction feedback.
Visible focus, exact-value financial transitions, a Pause/Play control and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Treat these as landing values; changes here do not alter the app's eight selectable accent palettes or light/dark themes.

rules.name: The Fixed Logo Color Rule
rules.body: Personal accents and interface theme tokens never recolor the logo. Use the dedicated logo roles for canonical Green mark/Forest outlined wordmark on light surfaces and canonical Bloom Mint for both on dark surfaces. Preserve the generated geometry and use `logo-inverse` for an explicit inverse application.

rules.name: The Surface Pair Rule
rules.body: Resolve `action` with `on-action`, and `spotlight` with `on-spotlight`/`spotlight-detail`, in the same active appearance. General surface, reading ink and interface Green are separate roles; the fixed logo palette remains independent.

rules.name: The Outlined Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Render the supplied outlined Manrope 700 wordmark, `Subloom` with an uppercase S, without a trailing period; interface font loading must not change its geometry.

rules.name: The Landing Heading Emphasis Rule
rules.body: The owner explicitly authorizes Green keywords and selective underlines on this landing page. Keep the existing Manrope face and weight, use nonitalic emphasis, and underline selected phrases with a (0.045 em) stroke offset (0.13 em). Use resolved Green on ordinary fields and the dedicated privacy highlight on the spotlight panel. This narrow exception does not revise the global brand guidance or permit changing the wordmark.

rules.name: The Numeric Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep the sample currency symbol, decimal precision and period label readable together when selection changes the amount.

rules.name: The Gated Illustration Motion Rule
rules.body: Continuous illustration loops run only when the scene intersects, the document is visible, motion is enabled and the system has not requested reduced motion. The inline Pause motion / Play motion control below hero reassurance stops/resumes loops and disables pointer-depth updates while paused. Keep the logo static and retain useful content at every animation state.

rules.name: The One Master Rule
rules.body: Read `../brand/GUIDE.md` before changing a brand application. `components/brand.tsx` consumes generated `components/brand-identity.ts`, derived from `../brand/source/identity.json`; never redraw or retype a local logo.

rules.name: The Illustrative Cost Rule
rules.body: Present repeated-payment arithmetic as an illustrative cost, never as measured or guaranteed savings. Keep review labels, original-currency units and provider-managed cancellation explicit in feature previews.

dos: Do use the generated Fourfold Bloom logo, fixed light/inverse colors and supplied outlined wordmark.
Do inherit the existing forest/mint identity and local Manrope/DM Sans fonts.
Do keep heading emphasis local, respect System/Light/Dark preference and use paired semantic foregrounds.
Do regenerate social images from canonical artwork and keep light-first metadata and explicit alternative text.
Do keep illustrative data labeled and preserve original-currency product claims.
Do connect each bento card to a real product task and keep review/cancellation responsibilities explicit.
Do preserve visible focus, the inline Pause/Play control, visibility gates and the reduced-motion override.
Do animate exact final sample totals and keep native FAQ answers usable before JavaScript.
Do keep local marketing adaptations scoped to this landing project.
donts: Don't recolor the logo with a personal accent, retype it, add a trailing period or invent a sprout, paired leaf or eight-petal alternate.
Don't promote this page's composition or pill controls into app-wide requirements.
Don't hide essential information behind entrance animation or show intermediate animated money values.
Don't animate the logo, run illustration loops offscreen or remove motion controls.
Don't replace authentic product artwork with unrelated decorative imagery.
Don't present the illustrative annual charge as guaranteed savings or imply that import/receipt previews bypass review.
